messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

So we can provide pack_size [null, null, 12] but null is not number. Maybe we can provide [1,1,12] but that would indicate pack sizes. But apples and rice might be per unit. We could just omit pack_size entirely? But then array length mismatch? The function expects pack_size optional. If omitted, default not used. So we can just not include pack_size. But the user wants 12 cans of bottled water. The function may not support quantity. But we can pass pack_size [12] for bottled water only? But array length must equal product_list. So we need to provide pack_size array of same length. We could provide [1,1,12] meaning 1 apple, 1 rice, 12 water. That seems okay. Let's do that.
